display_name_zh: 突变事件—CRISPR基因依赖双向分析

all_mutation_gene_annotations.coverage: all mutation genes with at least one retained record among CRISPR Gene Dependency models

mutation_to_target.meaning: fix one mutation event and rank retained dependency targets

target_to_mutation.meaning: fix one dependency target and rank retained mutation events

pair.meaning: return retained evidence for one directed mutation-target pair

ambiguity_rules.hotspot_gene: Distinguish a Hotspot mutation event from a user-selected dependency target gene.
ambiguity_rules.mutation_without_event_definition: Report available Damaging, Hotspot, and AnySelected counts before choosing a functional event.
ambiguity_rules.direction_without_roles: Identify which entity is the mutation event and which is the CRISPR dependency target.

metric_rules.CRISPRGeneDependency: positive mutant-minus-control difference means mutant models are more dependent
metric_rules.CRISPRGeneEffect: negative mutant-minus-control difference means mutant models are more dependent

event_state.unknown: missing event value is excluded and must not be converted to wild type

statistical_contract.complete_cases: For every event-target pair, exclude missing event or dependency values before applying thresholds and reporting n_mut/n_wt.
statistical_contract.effect: mean dependency in mutant complete cases minus mean dependency in wild-type complete cases
statistical_contract.test: Welch two-sample t-test with effect confidence interval

multiple_testing.mutation_to_target: BH across dependency targets for the fixed mutation event
multiple_testing.target_to_mutation: BH across mutation events for the fixed dependency target
multiple_testing.lineage: Record and correct each lineage/query family separately

statistical_contract.pan_cancer_confounding: Report within-lineage results or a lineage-adjusted model in addition to an unadjusted pan-cancer comparison.
statistical_contract.legacy_score: Scores from scripts 09-11 are exploratory visualization priorities only and must not be interpreted as significance, cancer specificity, or validated synthetic lethality.

interpretation: The two directions are row and column queries of one directed mutation-event by dependency-target association matrix. Results are observational candidates, not causal or experimentally validated synthetic lethality.
